data.name: Anupom
data.gender_notes: Anupom is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit roots ‘anu’ meaning ‘near’ or ‘close’ and ‘pom’ meaning ‘intimate’ or ‘beloved’. In Hindu mythology, Anupom refers to someone who is very close to a deity or a loved one. The name Anupom carries the meaning “Near, Close, Intimate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anupom usually hope their child will grow to embody near, close, intimate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes deep connection and devotion.
data.etymology: Anupom belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Near, Close, Intimate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anupom total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
